claims.claim: OINK v0.7.0 and Hugo Extended compatibility boundary
OINK page Markdown and llms.txt outputs
Hugo page outputs replace kind-level outputs
Privileged generation and static site build require a credential boundary
Periodic reconciliation is the completeness path and webhooks accelerate it
Evidence must bind source or collector-owned observation revisions
LLMs can extract and draft but cannot prove open-world completeness
Human-reviewed PR is the default, with evidence-gated limited autonomy later
Five separate quality dimensions are preferable to a composite score
